findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) via Dynamic Template Include - Flag Captured
findings.description: The /error endpoint uses a dynamic Jinja2 template include directive `{% include error_type %}` where error_type is user-controlled. By uploading a malicious HTML file via the profile image upload feature and including it through path traversal (../images/exploit.html), an attacker can execute arbitrary Jinja2 template expressions. This was exploited to achieve remote code execution via `request.application.__globals__.__builtins__.__import__('os').popen().read()` and read the system flag.
